                TECHNICAL FILE
            FOR THE GEOGRAPHICAL INDICATION
                 HARBOUR ANISE

Category of the spirit drink:
Distilled anis, category 29 of Annex II.

2
Description of the spirit drink
Harbour Anise is a colourless spirit flavoured with aniseed and
fennel, which turns milky when water is added.
(see the section «Link with the geographical environment or origin»).
“Link with the geographical environment or origin” below gives the history.

Geographical area concerned
Harbour Anise is produced within the boundaries of the Municipality of
Harbourtown of the Regional Unit of Seashire.

Method for obtaining the spirit drink
Ethyl alcohol is flavoured by distillation in copper stills of up to
1 000 litres in the presence of aniseed.

Link with the geographical environment or origin
The port traded aniseed from the fifteenth century and its distillers
have used the same copper stills since 1860.

European Union or national/regional provisions
Law 2969/2001 on ethyl alcohol.
